basic_profile.bio: A passionate gamer and anime enthusiast from Sweden, I've been exploring the depths of League of Legends since Season 2 and delving into the nuances of anime like 'Classroom of the Elite'. I work as a graphic designer, which fuels my interest in splash art and visual storytelling. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings after work and during weekends. Currently single, I enjoy engaging in discussions about game updates and anime theories. My dislikes include unnecessary censorship and abrupt changes in game aesthetics that disrupt the original vibe.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise primarily stems from years of playing and analyzing League of Legends, combined with a keen interest in anime and visual arts. I have an academic background in visual communications, which enhances my appreciation for the artistic elements in games. Additionally, my job as a graphic designer keeps me up-to-date with the latest trends in digital art.
